detailed_description: iCal Parser reads pasted or uploaded ICS calendar text in the browser and extracts VEVENT entries into a simple event table. After you paste iCal content or choose an .ics file, click Parse to view each event's summary, start time, end time, and location; when events are found, you can export the parsed event objects as JSON for deeper inspection. The parser also keeps common fields such as description, organizer, attendees, status, categories, and RRULE in the JSON output. It is useful for quickly checking calendar exports, debugging small ICS snippets, or reviewing event data without importing it into a calendar app. Timezone identifiers are not expanded into full timezone databases, so verify timezone-sensitive schedules in the calendar system that will publish or consume the file.
usage_steps: Paste iCal/ICS content into the text area or upload an .ics file.
Click Parse and review the event table for summary, start, end, and location.
Use Export JSON when you need the parsed event fields for debugging or handoff.
usage_examples: Inspect a calendar export before sharing it with a teammate.
Debug whether an ICS snippet contains the expected times, locations, and JSON fields.
